title: Clamp an end stop bracket onto a DIN rail against a terminal block and tighten screw
instruction: Slide the end stop bracket along the DIN rail flush against the terminal block, hold it snug, and tighten the clamping screw with the screwdriver, then return the screwdriver and clear both arms.
context: Electricians (SOC 47-2111; 762,600 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023), electrical and electronic equipment assemblers (SOC 51-2022; 195,840), and industrial machinery mechanics (SOC 49-9041; 412,650), totaling 1,371,090 workers, build and service industrial control panels and automation cabinets. Assembling DIN-rail terminal strips requires securing the terminal block stack with a heavy-duty screw-clamp end bracket (Phoenix Contact CLIPFIX 35-5). The worker slides the bracket against the outer terminal block, holds the stack tight under axial compression to prevent block tilting or loose busbar alignment, and tightens the captive M4 screw to lock the steel clamping foot onto the rail underside.
setup: Station table with a slotted 35 x 7.5 mm steel DIN rail (length 250 mm, axis along Y) bolted to a workstation panel at x 26 cm, y 0 cm, holding a stack of four 5.2 mm wide terminal blocks (Phoenix Contact UT 2.5) centered at y 0 cm. A screw-clamp end stop bracket (Phoenix Contact CLIPFIX 35-5, width 9.5 mm, captive slotted M4 screw) is positioned loose on the rail at y -8 cm. A slotted terminal screwdriver (3.5 mm blade, 80 mm shank, 18 mm handle) rests on a tool rest at x 22 cm, y 18 cm.
scoring: Score 1.0 when the end stop bracket is seated flush against the terminal block stack (gap <= 0.5 mm), the clamping screw is torqued tight (screw advance >= 0.6 mm, torque >= 0.4 N*m) resisting a 20 N lateral proof push with slip <= 0.5 mm, the screwdriver is returned to its tool rest, and both robot arms clear >= 20 mm, stationary for 1.0 s. Partial credit: 0.75 for clamped and proof-held but hands or tool unreleased; 0.50 for end stop flush against terminal block with screwdriver engaged in screw; 0.25 for end stop positioned against terminal block. Score 0 if terminal block stack displaced > 5 mm, end stop knocked off rail, or slip > 2 mm under proof push.
reset_notes: Place the terminal block stack at y 0 cm on the DIN rail. Place the loose end stop bracket at y -8 cm with its screw backed out 1 turn. Place the screwdriver on its tool rest at x 22 cm, y 18 cm.
fidelity: Slotted 35x7.5 mm steel DIN rail with top-hat profile. Four rigid terminal blocks. CLIPFIX 35-5 end bracket with sliding clamp foot and 0.7 mm/turn M4 screw joint. 3.5 mm slotted screwdriver with blade-slot mating constraint. 20 N spring proof push. Full contact physics and gripper clearance checks.
